scripts.//build:1: src/generated/prisma is gitignored, so a fresh clone has no client: generate before building or the build dies on `Module not found: @/generated/prisma/client`.
scripts.//build:2: --webpack, deliberately. Turbopack resolves native packages through content-hashed SYMLINKS in .next/node_modules (better-sqlite3-<hash> -> ../../node_modules/better-sqlite3). Those cannot survive an FTP upload, and a build that boots here dies on the host with `Cannot find module 'better-sqlite3-<hash>'`. The webpack build emits no .next/node_modules at all, so the release is portable — and a third the size. `next dev` still uses Turbopack.
